Apple iPhone 18 Pro Data Leaked in Tata Electronics Breach

Sensitive data related to Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 Pro, including supplier lists, component details, and photos, has been exposed following a data breach at Tata Electronics. The leak, reportedly a ransomware attack by the World Leaks group, has raised concerns about Apple's manufacturing strategy and the security of its supply chain. The incident highlights Tata Electronics' growing importance as a manufacturing partner for Apple outside of China.
